name: AI generation
grid: Built with the AI development assistant, without hand-written code
desc: The AI development assistant generates standardized elements directly from element specifications. Six automated checks and runtime feedback validate the results.
lead: Business requirements in, system capabilities out. The AI development assistant generates standardized elements from platform specifications, without hand-written code.
what: Automatic generation in JitAI means more than AI helping you write code. AI produces system components directly under platform contracts: models, services, pages, workflows and agents are all delivered as elements that conform to specifications and are recognized by the runtime.
what_points: Describe requirements in a conversation; AI breaks them into elements and generates each one
The output is standardized elements, rather than scattered code snippets
Elements enter execution after passing all six automated checks
pain: Traditional AI coding: an open programming space permits unbounded types of errors, and output still requires compilation and deployment
Low-code platforms: people configure controls manually, while complex logic remains difficult to express
Outsourced development: requirements become documents and then code, with delivery measured in months
how: Contract-constrained generation
Type specifications constrain the form of AI output, reducing unbounded errors to enumerable categories
Six automated checks
Validate source code, app relationships, builds, loading, functionality and runtime behavior
Validation as feedback
Validation results and runtime exceptions return directly to development AI without manual retelling
Required design clarification
Unresolved ambiguity prevents a design from being confirmed; persisted records contain facts rather than conversation history
quote: AI produces elements inside the system under contracts, rather than writing code outside it.

name: Business twins
grid: Map real business operations across scenarios
desc: The system mirrors business reality: objects, field semantics, relationships, state rules and processes all have representations that give AI the full business picture.
lead: Mirror business reality in the system: business objects, processes and rules each have a representation, giving AI the full picture.
what: Business twins are a prerequisite for AI to understand a business. JitAI's element model places business semantics and technical components together: an order is more than a table, customer credit is more than a field, and state transition rules live on the elements themselves.
what_points: Elements carry business objects, field semantics, relationship constraints and state rules
AI sees the full landscape of objects and elements, rather than only function names and parameters
Parent Apps define shared rules; child Apps override elements by name, accommodating both headquarters and branches
pain: External agents: API access exposes only function names, parameters and return values
Missing business context: business objects, field semantics, relationship constraints and state rules remain invisible
Conflicting rules: headquarters needs consistency while branches need flexibility, creating ongoing tension in the system
how: Elements carry semantics
Business semantics and technical components live together, where AI can read them directly
App inheritance
Parent Apps hold shared rules; child Apps override same-name elements with local rules
Full visibility
The full landscape of objects and elements is available to AI, beyond interface and API views
Rules as elements
State transitions, approval chains and validation rules are all elements AI can understand
quote: For AI to understand a business, the business must actually be represented in the system.

name: AI-native
desc: AI is a first-class element: it shares specifications, builds and governance with business elements and is scheduled by the runtime across development and operations.
lead: AI is a first-class element of the system, able to perceive the system, understand the business, invoke capabilities and drive execution.
what: External AI tools do not make an architecture AI-native. In JitAI, AI and business elements share specifications, builds and governance, with unified scheduling by the runtime. AI spans development and operations: it helps build the system and runs inside it.
what_points: AI is a first-class element under the same specifications as business elements
AI can perceive, understand, invoke and drive the system
AI capabilities are governed together with the element system rather than operating outside it
pain: External agents: AI operates outside the system with only a partial view through APIs
Isolated capabilities: AI knowledge and permissions remain on individual desktops and cannot be reused
Disconnected systems: AI and the business system remain separate and grow further apart with use
how: AI as a first-class element
Agents and business elements share specifications, builds and governance
Across both sides
AI participates in both system development and operations, bringing intelligence to each
Unified scheduling
The runtime schedules AI without people manually carrying context between tools
Capabilities as elements
LLMs, Skills, RAG and plugins are members of element families, composed as needed
quote: AI-native means making systems understandable and usable by AI.

name: Enterprise ownership
desc: Support private, multitenant SaaS and hybrid deployments. Keep data within your environment and element source code in enterprise-controlled version management, without dependence on one model provider.
lead: Deploy privately and keep data within your environment. Manage element source code in your own version control, without being locked into one model provider.
what: Enterprise data and system assets should belong to the enterprise. JitAI supports private deployment with data kept within the enterprise environment, multitenant SaaS and hybrid deployment. Element source code is the single business source of truth and stays in the enterprise's own version management system.
what_points: Private deployment keeps data within your environment
Element source code is managed under enterprise-owned version control
A model gateway adapts multiple model providers and routes requests by scenario
pain: Data concerns: business data leaving the enterprise environment creates security and compliance barriers
Vendor lock-in: dependence on one model or platform weakens negotiating power and makes migration difficult
Loss of assets: system assets remain scattered across service providers rather than retained by the enterprise
how: Three deployment options
Choose private deployment, multitenant SaaS or a hybrid deployment as needed
Model gateway
Adapt multiple model providers and route judgment and deterministic logic according to the scenario
Enterprise-owned source
Element source code is the single business source of truth, under enterprise-owned version management
Open integration
IM channels, third-party systems and open APIs include authentication and auditing
quote: Keep data within your environment, own your source code and choose your models freely.

name: Two modes, one foundation
grid: AI and application functions share one system
desc: People use forms and approvals; agents interpret intent and invoke capabilities. Both share data models, service functions, permission checks and audit trails.
lead: People and agents take different paths through one system while sharing the same foundation: data models, service functions, permissions and auditing.
what: Two modes on one foundation resolve the split between AI and business systems. People use forms and approvals; agents interpret intent, invoke authorized services and record their actions. Both paths share data models, service functions, permission checks and audit trails.
what_points: People and agents share the same data models and service functions
One set of permission checks and audit trails, without parallel systems
Agents do not write directly to the database; changes go through standard business interfaces
pain: Separate permission systems: AI bypasses business permissions and processes
Audit gaps: AI actions cannot be traced or rolled back
Accuracy risks: deterministic logic such as financial amounts and inventory is delegated to language models
how: Shared source and foundation
Development and operations share element contracts, and people and AI share business context
Enforced constraints
Agents do not write directly to databases; all changes pass through standardized business interfaces
Deterministic execution
Exact logic for amounts, inventory and state transitions executes outside language models
Separate responsibilities
AI uses evidence to assess situations; system rules make determinations, with a record throughout
quote: AI handles judgment and decisions under uncertainty; system functions execute deterministic transactions.

name: Robust by specification
desc: Type specifications constrain AI output, reducing unbounded errors to enumerable categories. Six automated checks validate each layer from source code to runtime.
lead: Element specifications are the single contract between development and operations. Type constraints make errors enumerable, and six automated checks validate everything from source to runtime.
what: JitAI constrains all output through element specifications. Types define declarations, resources, capabilities, loading and validation. AI produces within these constraints, reducing errors from unlimited possibilities to an enumerable list, then eliminating them through six stages of automated validation.
what_points: Standardization: Types define declarations, resources, capabilities, loading and validation
Self-description: declarations and resources live together as a complete unit
Self-loading and replacement: resolve by fullName and override by name without modifying the parent App
pain: Unbounded errors: unconstrained programming allows types of AI errors that cannot be exhaustively enumerated
Manual recovery: without automatic feedback, errors must be found through manual testing
Weak constraints: relying only on prompts leaves output quality unpredictable
how: Type constraints
Specifications guide the generation of standardized elements, connecting development directly to execution
Six-stage validation
Source → app relationships → build → loading → functional validation → runtime validation
Three disciplines
Specifications before code; collaborate only through public capabilities; validate changes from the entry App
Context retrieved on demand
An element is the smallest unit that can be independently built and validated
quote: Errors become enumerable, and quality is upheld by the system rather than relying on people alone.

name: Continuous evolution
desc: Hot-pluggable, hot-updatable elements take effect once requirements are confirmed. Three feedback streams drive self-evolution and deepen the system's understanding of the business.
lead: Once requirements are confirmed, system changes take effect immediately without waiting for compilation, deployment or a release window. Continuous runtime feedback helps the system understand the business better over time.
what: As business changes, the system must keep pace. JitAI elements support hot plugging and hot updates, allowing new requirements to enter the system as new elements and take effect immediately. Runtime state, exceptions and logs continuously return to development AI, forming a feedback loop that drives self-evolution.
what_points: Hot-pluggable, hot-updatable elements make changes effective immediately
Three feedback streams: system runtime, agents and people
Child Apps extend behavior with same-name overrides without changing parent App behavior
pain: Release cycles: even small changes require compilation, deployment and release windows measured in weeks
Growing rigidity: a system becomes fixed at launch and cannot keep pace with business changes
Lost feedback: operational problems never reach development, so mistakes recur
how: JitNode runtime
Standardized, self-describing elements with hot plugging and hot updates
Feedback loop
Runtime results automatically return to development, closing the iteration loop
Three feedback streams
System runtime feedback, agent feedback and human feedback
Extension through overrides
Child Apps override same-name elements with local rules, supporting different customers on one foundation
quote: The system understands your business better with use, and its capabilities grow with your needs.

name: Control and governance
desc: Shared permissions and data scopes cover people and agents. Pre-call authorization, end-to-end auditing and sensitive-data filtering keep AI behavior under control.
lead: People and agents share organizations, roles and data scopes. Every business action can be audited, traced and rolled back.
what: Control is a prerequisite for agents to enter production systems. JitAI brings agents under the same governance as business elements: shared permissions and data scopes, authorization before backend calls, end-to-end audit records and automatic sensitive-data filtering.
what_points: Shared permissions and data scopes for people and agents
Permission checks before calls; page visibility does not substitute for authorization
End-to-end auditing makes each business action traceable and reversible
pain: Governance gaps: AI capabilities remain on individual desktops, beyond unified enterprise management
Unauthorized access: AI connects directly to databases and bypasses business rules and authorization
Missing records: when something goes wrong, AI actions and their supporting evidence cannot be reconstructed
how: One governance system
All elements and agents share permissions, data scopes and audit trails
Backend permission enforcement
The base framework enforces authorization before calls
End-to-end auditing
Record business actions step by step to support traceability and rollback
Sensitive-data filtering
Keep secrets out of logs and sensitive data off disk
quote: People set goals, handle exceptions and hold final responsibility; AI executes, assesses and records its actions.

name: Conversation + source code
grid: Build without touching code, customize with source when needed
desc: Conversational development lets business users work without touching source code. Source remains visible and editable, so developers can take over for deeper customization.
lead: Build through conversation by default, without business users touching code. Source remains visible and editable whenever deeper customization is needed.
what: JitAI does not lock enterprises into a single development method. Handle everyday needs through conversation with the AI development assistant. For deeper customization, developers can edit element source directly, because output consists of standard source code and design documents from the start, rather than a black box.
what_points: Conversational development: describe the business and let AI generate the system
Source code stays visible and editable, rather than hidden in a black box
Standard source code and design documents let the enterprise take over at any time
pain: Low-code black boxes: configuration stays under platform control, leaving no entry point for deeper customization
Code-only barriers: business users cannot participate and must queue every request for engineering
Difficult handovers: switching service providers means starting over, leaving previous assets behind
how: AI development assistant
Conversational development keeps business users away from source code by default
Source-code fallback
Visible, editable source lets developers work directly on complex scenarios
Persistent design documents
System design facts stay alongside source code so handovers retain context
A different development paradigm
Type constraints generate standardized elements, distinguishing this approach from free-form programming and specification-driven development
quote: Start with conversation and fall back to source code: both paths lead to the same system.
